description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:630-632 — issuer_has_crl_sign() calls KeyUsage::from_der and on parse failure uses .unwrap_or(false), returning false. The caller (check_revocation line 215) then returns Err(CrlSignMissing). A malformed-but-critical KeyUsage extension should return CrlParseError (structural defect), not CrlSignMissing (missing bit). The behavior is fail-closed (rejects), but the wrong error variant reaches the caller, making the root cause undiagnosable. Fix: propagate the decode error as CrlParseError before the crl_sign() call.
title: malformed KeyUsage on CRL issuer returns wrong error
